tone.summary: A tight, high-gain signal chain utilizing a boost and distortion for aggressive rhythm tones, paired with the Recti amp model and 4x12 cabinet to achieve modern metal crunch.

rig.name: System of a Down - BYOB - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Eliminate hum and unwanted noise inherent in high-gain recordings.
Provide extra punch and attack for tight palm-muted chugging.
Establish the core high-gain crunch and aggressive tone required for nu-metal.
blocks.gap: The 'Distortion' model is a general choice to emulate Mesa/5150 type gain, as no specific 5150 model exists in the compact catalog.

blocks.purpose: Provide the massive, modern high-gain foundation characteristic of nu-metal.
Provide a modern, punchy cabinet sound suitable for aggressive rhythm playing.
blocks.gap: The Mess 4x12 is chosen over the UK Vintage 4x12 to maintain a more modern and scooped character.

blocks.purpose: Aggressively scoop the mids and tighten the low-end response for a modern metal sound.
Used for clean contrast parts if needed, but kept off by default to maintain dry rhythm tone.
blocks.gap: Chorus is generally avoided in the main crunch tone, but included here as a potential tool for clean sections.

blocks.purpose: Add rhythmic depth and space during clean or transitional parts.
Provide a subtle, dry ambience for clean contrast parts without muddying the rhythm tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for modern metal crunch.

proposals.reason: Enhance the perceived tightness and dimension of the high-gain rhythm tone.
